text:
sasha: Quick preflight — planning to push the Tue 22:00 UTC change window. Need a quick cross-service sync: API, runtime, console, router. Can everyone confirm pins and rollback criteria?

alex: I can take runtime. Planning to pin runtime -> 4.0.1-rc3 on staging and 4.0.0-prod on prod fallback. Will post exact image tags in a minute.

maria: Console PR merged, release notes updated at https://go/internal/release-notes/console-2.8. Add a note about header-split impact on devtools.

tim: Router needs KV eviction verification — header split changes alter routing keys. If eviction threshold hits, we want immediate fallback to router v1.9.3.

sasha: Good. For API: pin api service to v2.3.1 and keep v2.2.x as warm fallback. Who owns the API pin? @kevin?

kevin: Yep, I'll pin API to v2.3.1. I'll also add a runbook snippet: if 5xx rate > 1% for 3 continuous minutes, revert to v2.2.9.

alex: Runtime image tags: `ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:4.0.1-rc3-20240214` for canary, `ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:4.0.0-prod` as fallback. Canary will be 5% traffic for 10m then 25% for 20m if no regressions.

deploy-bot: Staging canary for runtime passed smoke (latency, mem) at 1746501380 :white_check_mark: 

maria: Console release note excerpt: "Console 2.8 introduces header-split support. See migration notes — opt-in via feature flag. Non-opted routes unaffected."

tim: Router team: we validated eviction under test load. One outstanding: config key `router.kv.eviction_margin` default must be bumped from 0.05 -> 0.12 for safe rollout. Can we include that in deploy?

sasha: Let's set that config in the release bundle. Alex, can runtime handle the slightly higher memory pressure?

alex: Yes, runtime has the kv-cache headroom in the rc build. I ran quick soak; add the config change to the runtime configmap: `router.kv.eviction_margin: 0.12` and bump the runtime GC threshold to 0.7.

kevin: I'll update the API health-check to emit `eviction_pressure` metric so we can alert before 5xx spike.

devops-bot: Preflight checklist: (1) All pins set? partial, (2) Release notes updated? yes, (3) Canary plan recorded? yes, (4) Rollback triggers documented? partial. Run `./scripts/deploybot preflight --thread=1746501234` to re-evaluate.

sasha: Rollback criteria proposal: immediate rollback on (a) sustained p50 latency +30% over baseline for 5m, (b) 5xx > 1% as kevin said, (c) eviction_pressure > 0.8 for 2m. Agree?

maria: Agree on the criteria. I'll add the rollback bullets to the console notes and link them from the main release doc.

kevin: Also propose a soft-fallback path: if API error rate spikes only for a subset of routes, traffic-steer those routes back to v2.2.* via routing rules before full rollback. That reduces blast radius.

tim: Router can do per-route steer. We'll prepare the reroute play: `router steer set --route /chat --variant v2.2.9 --weight 100` (runbook snippet).

alex: One practical: pin the runtime artifact in the orchestrator config, not just image tag. I'll push a PR to ops-config with the pinned digest.

sasha: OK owners: alex runtime, kevin api pin + alerts, tim router steers + config, maria release notes + runbook. I'll run the final checklist 30m before window. Any blockers?

kevin: None from infra. I'll wire the alert and post the Grafana panel link.

maria: No blockers. I added the runbook section: "how to verify console feature flag opt-in state".

alex: PR for pinned digest up at https://gh/redwood/ops-config/pulls/512 — includes `runtime.digest: sha256:abc123...`

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for Tue 22:00 UTC. Will perform 5% -> 25% -> 100% steps with automated checks. Manual hold at 25% for 20m.

sasha: Perfect. I'll post a short release-notes summary in #general after we cut. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 

kevin: One last note — if we hit any unexpected interoperability errors between console and runtime, prefer rolling console back first (less stateful).
